notes: The Last Light of Orio - A complete narrative adventure game about memory, sacrifice, and what we choose to keep. Features: 4 chapters with branching narrative, dialogue with consequences, resource management (Memory Fragments, Vitality, Resolve), relationship system with 5 characters each with arcs, inventory with equippable items, quest log with main/side quests, journal/codex lore system, save/load via IndexedDB with localStorage fallback, procedural audio synthesis via Web Audio API, atmospheric particle effects, full keyboard navigation, accessibility support (reduced motion, high contrast, screen reader labels), responsive design from 320px to 2560px+. All code, narrative, systems, and design authored from scratch. No external assets or libraries beyond Google Fonts. Tested in Chrome/Firefox - runs from file:// with limited save functionality (IndexedDB requires HTTP), full functionality on local server.
